summary_1line: Victor recounts his obsessive pursuit of the creature across continents to the Arctic, ending with Walton rescuing him and recording his tragic reflections.

image_candidates.scene_text: Victor kneels in the dark cemetery beside the graves of his family, swearing vengeance while the wind stirs the trees.
Under a rising moon, the monstrous figure flees across the landscape as Victor glimpses his distorted shape and gives chase.
On the shattered Arctic ice, Victor drifts on a shrinking floe with dead dogs and jagged ice mountains as a distant ship appears.
